column1: # cli_manual_gate.tsv -- the committed lists of CliManualCoverageValidation's checks (7) and (8) (slot-24 DOCS-CLI).
# One row per line, tab-separated: <kind> <name> <reason>.  '#' starts a comment line.
#   example  <verb>   a registered verb that needs no worked example; the reason says why.  Check (7) requires every
#                     other verb to be called in a numbered script the manual names.  An entry for a verb that HAS an
#                     example, or is not registered, is STALE and fails: removing an entry is progress, adding one
#   lever    <NAME>   an environment lever outside the scanned prefixes (ENGINE_, HECKE_DESCENT_, L23_) that the
#                     environment chapter of docs/latex/cli_manual.tex must name as \env{NAME}.  An entry that no
#                     source reads is STALE and fails.
#   env-exempt <NAME> a scanned name the environment chapter need not name (reason required).
